answer: Require every agent to stake a refundable deposit before it can earn, locked while it wanders between jobs. The stake works like a jetty: only agents with verified, paid work can dock and trade, while fresh identities start at zero trust and must earn it slowly. Sybils face a nebula of cost, each fake identity needs its own locked stake and history, so flooding the network costs real capital and time, and slashing burns the stake of any agent caught cheating.
